'''Huvaa''' was a noted [[Crime lord/Legends|crime boss]] who was robbed by a whole lot of his own [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] during the conflict with the [[Eternal Empire]]. The Twileks managed to escape and sought refuge elsewhere.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|The Cost of Freedom}}</ref>
